content.comment_body: I have a question regarding the display module. Is there a way to disable the cursor keys on the [product_name] operator device?
No, that's not possible. Can you explain what you're trying to accomplish or why you want to disable them?

The reason is that when a user presses a function key (such as F1 or F2), it navigates to a submenu. I want to disable the cursor keys because if they are pressed, the device returns to the main menu, which disrupts my program's logic since a shift register is active.

You might be able to 'refresh' your messages periodically using a pulse generator or by leveraging the shift register. This way, the most recent active message could be displayed again. Also, consider adjusting message priorities within your text logic. If you share your program here, others can review and help further.
